text: Regarding the shot noise ⟨i²_shot⟩ = 2eI_ph B in an optical receiver, which statement is correct?
choices: It can be eliminated by using a lower-noise transimpedance amplifier
It is an irreducible quantum noise floor from the discreteness of photons and electrons; it cannot be removed by better circuit design
It scales as the square of the bandwidth
It is independent of the photocurrent
explanation: Shot noise arises from the discrete, random arrival of photons and electrons, making it a fundamental quantum floor that no amplifier can remove — only lower bandwidth or higher signal power improves the SNR. It scales linearly with both photocurrent I_ph and bandwidth B, so 'independent of photocurrent' and 'square of bandwidth' are both wrong.
